claimVersions.text: in particular O(n² m^{2.575} log(nm) ε^{-2} log(1/δ)) via minimum-index witnesses
Lemma main_result_core (accuracy): Pr[p(q_F) ∉ (1±ε)|L(A^u)|^{-1}] ≤ 1/4 per core run (external Lean proves 3/16)
Lemma main_result_core (time): one core run costs O(n²·MM(m)·log(nm)·ε^{-2}), m = max_i |Q^i|
Lemma proba_p(q): in N*, Pr[∃q, p(q) ∉ (1±ε)|L(q)|^{-1}] ≤ 1/16
Lemma proba_S(q): in N*, Pr[Σ_{r,q}|S^r(q)| ≥ θ] ≤ 1/8
Proposition chernoff_intersections: Pr[Σ 1_{E_b} ≥ B/2] ≤ (4p)^{B/2} under Pr[∩_S E_b] ≤ p^{|S|}
Lemmas expectation_of_singleton / pair / C_A_terms and induction_lemma (martingale-style conditional expectations)
Spirit coupling: Pr_{N*}[some p(q) out of range] ≤ Σ_q Pr_{N^s}[bar p(q) out of range]
eq. union_sel at σ = min equals eq. union
Algorithms union_1 / union_witness compute eq. union / union_sel given a correct cache; cache'_i and cache_i are correct
Program (charged, cache-based) has the same output law as the Pseudocode transcription
Median amplification: per-run failure ≤ 1/4 and μ = ⌈8 ln(1/δ)⌉ independent runs give failure ≤ e^{-μ/8} ≤ δ
Total time = μ · (core time) + O(μ) median + preprocessing
Remark tightness: the (n+1) factor cannot be improved on the one-state automaton
